pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **The Noisemaker Rafe, your Germany pick is as desperate as a goalkeeper without gloves.** Look at me, kid, LET ME TELL YOU SOMETHING—thinking Ecuador, Mexico, and a Scotland pick from the depths of Scottish football obscurity would pave your way to fantasy glory is like trying to score goals with flip-flops. Gunner, aka Bubba G, sitting in first with 47 points, your meticulous strategy of going for African powerhouses like Senegal and Morocco makes everyone else's roster look like a punter's midnight disaster. But here's a shocker: today’s face-offs might just tilt the scales. Germany may be due for an uptick or just another round of heartbreak, but don’t think your eco-friendly picks are saving the planet OR your roster. And Gayden, aka The Backpass Assassin, your England selection is perpetually on the verge of "it’s coming home," yet here you are, wallowing in fourth. My prediction? Bubba G solidifies his hold at the top while The Noisemaker continues his symphony of chaos in the basement. Mic drop, folks!
